# Exceptions for scripts/check-english.ps1 - one glob per line.
#
# Only for genuine false positives: test data whose German text is part of the
# case under test, payload characters, or generated files. Never to silence a
# file that simply has not been translated yet - that would make the rule
# worthless.
#
# Every entry needs a reason in a comment above it.

# Delphi project files: the German strings are Excluded_Packages descriptions
# written by a German IDE installation. They name installed BPLs and are
# regenerated by the IDE, so translating them would be both pointless and
# undone on the next save.
Demo/FMX/FMXZint.dproj
Demo/VCL/ZintTest.dproj
Demo/VCL-QR-EPC/QREPC.dproj
UnitTests/DUnitXCmdTest.dproj
UnitTests/DUnitXGuiRunner.dproj
